tasks_completed.description: Meals draggable when edSlot is null (flight-day / 飞机餐): add synthetic board-default fallback
tasks_completed.changes: Line 867: replaced '|| null' with '|| (opt._type + ":board-default")'. Primary meal cards now always get a truthy mealDragOptionId even when editorDay.slots[type] is null.
tasks_completed.rationale: Flight-day meals have no edSlot configured in editor data, so all real option_id lookups return null. Synthetic fallback makes card draggable; drag payload option_id:null is still sent correctly on drop.

self_verification.notes: Playwright: all 27 meal primary cards draggable=true across 9 days. Flight-day cards (Day1 breakfast/lunch, Day9 breakfast) now data-option-id=breakfast:board-default. Drag-to-sidebar: /api/save POST option_id:null confirmed.
